description: Source code for a command-line tool that generates Protobuf IDL from Go structs, including package management, dependency resolution, and protoc invocation.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: Configuration for the protobuf code generator, including output directory, package lists, and flags.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Generator with default settings.

methods.name: BindFlags
methods.description: Binds command-line flags to the Generator's configuration fields.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main execution function that performs package loading, dependency resolution, code generation, protoc invocation, and file rewriting.

methods.name: deps
methods.description: Builds a map of package dependencies based on imports.

methods.name: importOrder
methods.description: Determines a topological order of packages based on dependencies.

methods.name: findAndRemoveNodesWithoutDependencies
methods.description: Finds packages with no incoming dependencies for topological sorting.

methods.name: removeEdgesFrom
methods.description: Removes dependency edges originating from a given package.
